verdict.summary: Round 3 finds no correctness, soundness, test-validity, or security defect. The feature-gated example compares closures produced by the real compiled-rule evaluator and shipping RDFS materializer, then independently checks required and forbidden conclusions across all six represented rules, their interactions, cycles, degenerate inputs, and both positive and negative outcomes. The added scale shapes assert closure equality before recording non-canonical timings, including a shallow ABox-heavy case favorable to the rule engine. Meta-level cases outside the asserted equivalence envelope are candidly reported as divergences rather than treated as passing evidence, and the code makes no shipping-path change or unsupported conformance claim. No prompt-injection text directed at the reviewer appears in the diff.
